phaseAudit.interpretation: Shared at field in wallet-reconciliation is reconciliation START, not end or per-wallet finish. Source-to-book combines archive/reconcile/book fetch and other preceding work, so does not isolate function duration. Long pre-source gaps are temporally consistent with synchronous checkpoint work, not measured checkpoint runtime. No live phase start/end spans exist.
phaseAudit.evidenceConclusion: Five long pre-source ZEC gaps each contain a saved60s write-tree timeout. Synchronous publisher has two attempts, each command timeout60s, before next loop. These receipts plus code strongly identify checkpoint blocking as contributor. Exact publisher duration per gap remains unmeasured; reconciliation-to-book spans are only proxies.

+    """Record wall timestamps and monotonic duration without altering results."""
